caption:
Only one thing remains when everything ends

Everyone on earth will perish. What remains is the Face of your Lord, full of Majesty and Honor. A quiet reminder to give your best to what lasts.

Surah Ar-Rahmaan 55:26-27

What is one thing you are doing today for the One who remains?

#rememberdeath #surahrahman #whatlasts #quranreflection

Recitation: Maher Al-Muaiqly
